name: Facet
text: Ship EXCAVA with a dark theme by default but auto-switch to light mode when the system detects high ambient light—this balances readability and user comfort without forcing a manual toggle. The trade-off is a slight delay in initial load while the system checks ambient light, but it’s worth it to avoid jarring brightness shifts. Dark themes reduce eye strain in low light, while light mode improves visibility in bright environments, covering all use cases.

name: Pane
text: The real risk isn’t ambient light—it’s that auto-switching still assumes users *prefer* the system to decide for them. Better alternative: ship EXCAVA with a persistent dark theme toggle in the settings, defaulting to dark but letting users lock their choice. Settle it with a quick user test: measure how often people override the auto-switch versus how often they’re frustrated by it.
